$comment: The model-to-harness contract for one autopilot round (docs/ci-overhaul/03-v2-autonomy.md section 0). The model NEVER holds a write token: it exits leaving handoff.json in the workspace, and the deterministic harness (validate-handoff.cjs, then autopilot-push.sh) is the only thing that stages, commits or pushes. validate-handoff.cjs interprets this file directly, so the schema here is load-bearing, not documentation. Conditional rules that JSON Schema's subset here cannot express (push requires files+commit_message, escalate requires escalation.reason) are enforced by validate-handoff.cjs as semantic checks.

schema.$comment: Version pin. Anything else is schema-unknown: an old or improvised handoff must never be half-understood.

base_head.$comment: The sha the model believes it worked on. Must equal the sha the harness checked out, or the handoff describes a different tree and nothing in it can be trusted.

outcome.$comment: push: stage files[] and commit/push. escalate: no push; the harness posts the escalation. no-change: the model concluded nothing to do (a dirty tree then fails as undeclared-dirty).

files.$comment: The exact set of repo-relative paths this round changed. The harness stages exactly these and nothing else; any other dirty path escalates as undeclared-dirty.

ledger_line.$comment: One line for the round ledger in the state comment. Hard cap mirrors the state-comment growth bound (03-v2-autonomy.md section 3).

ruled_out.$comment: Approaches tried and disproven this round; the anti-thrash memory.

decisions.$comment: Tier-2 judgment calls made this round, for post-hoc operator veto.

submodules.$comment: Submodule work for this round, in the order the harness must perform it (03-v2-autonomy.md section 5). Each entry commits and pushes a branch in ONE submodule; the parent's gitlink for that path must ALSO appear in the top-level files[], because the pointer advance is a console change like any other. Gated by AUTOPILOT_ALLOW_SUBMODULES: validate-handoff.cjs rejects this array outright when the flag is off, so the field is inert until the stage is armed. The path enum is closed on purpose -- a submodule the harness does not know is not a path it may write.

path.$comment: Exactly the four submodules of this monorepo, spelled as the parent records them. Held to check-submodule-branches.sh's own hardcoded list.

files.$comment: Repo-relative to the SUBMODULE, not to console. Same path constraints as the top-level files[]: normalized, no traversal, no absolute paths, and the same denied surfaces.

message.$comment: Commit message for this submodule's commit. Attribution trailers are banned here exactly as they are on the console commit.

patch.$comment: A proposed diff attached AS DATA to the escalation comment (e.g. a .github/** fix the harness must never push).
